compiled_state.title: GREEN: Amend _check_duplicate_pr to filter non-draft PRs only
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Amend _check_duplicate_pr() in plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh to only refuse when a NON-DRAFT open PR exists. Draft PRs (created by sprint Phase A) must pass the guard.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: merge-to-main-pr.sh while draft PR open → succeeds; while non-draft PR open → refused

## Change

In `_check_duplicate_pr()` (line ~235), change:

```bash
_existing=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number,url --jq '.[0].url' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [[ -n "$_existing" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: open PR already exists for branch $BRANCH: $_existing" >&2
    return 1
fi
```

To:

```bash
_existing=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number,url,isDraft \
    --jq 'map(select(.isDraft == false))[0].url' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [[ -n "$_existing" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: non-draft PR already exists for branch $BRANCH: $_existing" >&2
    return 1
fi
```

The `isDraft` field is a standard field in `gh pr list --json` output. The jq filter `map(select(.isDraft == false))[0].url` returns the URL of the first non-draft open PR, or null/empty if all open PRs are drafts.

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] _check_duplicate_pr uses `--json number,url,isDraft` and `map(select(.isDraft == false))[0].url`
- [ ] Error message updated to "non-draft PR already exists"
- [ ] T1 tests pass GREEN after this change (PASSED: ≥3 FAILED: 0 for the 3 new cases)
- [ ] All existing tests in test-merge-to-main-pr.sh still pass (no regressions)
- [ ] ShellCheck passes with no errors

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

comments.body: AC AMENDMENT (gap analysis — minor): Use 'map(select(.isDraft == false)) | .[0].url // empty' instead of 'map(select(.isDraft == false))[0].url' to ensure no literal 'null' string is returned when no non-draft PRs exist. The bash [[ -n "$_existing" ]] check treats 'null' as non-empty.
